summary: CNS Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K to disclose a private placement of common stock and pre-funded warrants. The company sold 650,000 shares at $2.30/share and pre-funded warrants for 9,143,479 shares at $2.299/warrant, raising ~$22.5M gross. The warrants are exercisable at $0.001 with a 4.99% beneficial ownership blocker. Proceeds will fund asset acquisition, working capital, and corporate purposes. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. No transaction category applies.
